verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents an official MCP server that lets agents in existing AI clients create indexes, add documents, configure settings (ranking rules, searchable attributes, faceting) and run searches through natural-language prompts. That covers the query and index-operation parts of the story. Analytics exists as a product feature, but nothing shows it is exposed through the MCP tool surface. missing for 10: evidence that analytics (query/click/conversion data) is available via MCP tools, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, detailed tool-level documentation
